power.loopypowers.blood.name: Blood
power.loopypowers.blood.description.over:
Blood is a power that revolves around 1v1s, able to keep people in fights and deal high damage quickly to single targets, but may struggle against groups.
It is intended to be a more simplistic power that expands upon your close-combat ability.
power.loopypowers.blood.description.pass: Your melee damage also inflicts a bleed that does additional damage over time, which is based on the damage dealt, meaning stronger weapons result in more bleed. Any bleed damage dealt heals you.
power.loopypowers.blood.description.prim: Damage yourself to cast a fast-moving whip that embeds into a target, bleeding them and pulling them to you.
power.loopypowers.blood.description.seco:
Shoot a slow moving projectile that can hit a single target, the projectile has two effects dependiing on if the target is bleeding or not:
Target is not bleeding - Apply slowness, weakness and bleed.
Target is bleeding - Pop the bleed, multiplying the remaining damage and applying it instantly, this is a burst tool.
power.loopypowers.blood.description.ulti: Shoot out a blood chain. If it hits a target they will now be bound to you. When bound they will take some of the damage you take instead of you. Going too far from each other will break the pact. Constant environmental damage is capped (so there will be a point where lava damage stops being applied)
power.loopypowers.cosmic.name: Cosmic
power.loopypowers.cosmic.description.ove: Cosmic is a damage based power, the whole gimmick revolves around low damage being done initially, but having huge damage come in bursts later due to the passive. All abilities revolve around this passive in different ways, and understanding how it works and how each ability interacts with it are fundamental for doing well with this power. The explanation for the passive and each ability should help with this.
power.loopypowers.cosmic.description.pas:
This is what your entire power revolves around. Your basic melee hits and some abilities apply a debuff called Fate, there are two elements to this debuff: 
 Fate damage: This is the amount of damage Fate currently stores, it increases with the hits you do and is indicated by the amount of dust coming off the effected entity. This has a hard cap, when an entity has reached max damage, hitting it will play a sound and display star particles.
 Fate Timer: This is the time until the stored fate damage is quickly applied, it is indicated by the orbiting sun around the entity, with faster orbit speeds meaning it is closer to detonation and extra fire particles will also appear when about to detonate. 
 When the timer expires, the entity will explode and have the debuff removed, quickly taking all of the damage that was stored over a few seconds. They will then be immune to building fate for a long time (if they survive).

 But, your melee hits do significantly less damage and the lost damage is stored as Fate, melee hits also reduce the fate timer. Fate damage also decays when the victim is not close to the caster.
power.loopypowers.cosmic.description.pri: Fire a hitscan beam that deals minor direct damage but stores significant Fate damage on the target and extends their timer significantly. The beam pierces through entities but not blocks. This is a lot more reliable than extending it via melee hits.
power.loopypowers.cosmic.description.sec: Launch into the air and slam down towards your crosshair. The impact applies a small amount of fate damage to nearby enemies but significantly reduces their fate timer by a percentage. So this can be used to trigger detonations on groups of enemies.
power.loopypowers.cosmic.description.ult:
Summon a slow-moving black hole a few blocks in front of you.
 This black hole travels slowly in the direction you cast it, having a large pull radius that gets stronger the closer entities are to the centre.
 Any entities in the centre of the black hole will take constant damage (this does not apply Fate damage) and their Fate timer will be quickly drained down.
 Essentially, this is a way to quickly drain fate and explode groups of entities over an area.
power.loopypowers.darkness.name: Darkness
power.loopypowers.darkness.description.o: Darkness is supposed to be a high damage, melee stealth power, with tools to get in and get out along with high amounts of bonus damage on hit, especially with higher tier weapons.
power.loopypowers.darkness.description.p: Deal bonus damage when hitting an entity from behind, this bonus damage uses a multiplier, so it improves with the weapon being used.
Shoot a slow projectile that on hitting an entity briefly blinds them, deals a small chunk of damage and teleports you behind them (should be in a safe place).
power.loopypowers.darkness.description.s: Temporarily transform into a cloud of mist, allowing you to fly freely. You will not be able to deal or receive damage in this form and will be immune to all slow effects (apart from blocks like cobwebs). Once finished, you will be invisible for a brief time.
power.loopypowers.darkness.description.u: Create a sphere of darkness, all entities in it are blinded, glowing and exposed, meaning you do bonus damage to entities in this bubble and it stacks multiplicatively with your backstab passive (so your backstab does even more increased damage, along with the bonus damage).
power.loopypowers.interdimensional.name: Interdimensional
power.loopypowers.interdimensional.descr: Interdimensional is a power that is centered around making and taking opportunities, able to separate out entities and take duels easily. The power also has some defensive utility, able to quickly escape or get brief damage immunity when under pressure.

You have a constant chance to start 'flickering', when flickering you cannot receive any damage from any source and have a chance to adapt to certain events. The chance to flicker increases when taking damage and goes on cooldown briefly after flickering.

Enter spectator mode briefly, being able to pass through blocks, fly and travel faster, leaving a visible trail of particles. When exiting spectator mode, do a burst of damage to nearby entities. You can end up inside blocks during this.

Shoot a slow, piercing projectile that banishes hit entities. Banished entities cannot move, attack, interact, or receive damage from any sources for a few seconds. Their location is indicated by particles and they can still see during banishment.

Create a 'fracture' at your location, this creates a series of cracks along the ground that create isolated 'sections' that entities must remain in. Any entities touching these cracks will be significantly slowed and take constant damage, the caster does not receive damage or slowness from these cracks. The intention of this is to force groups to become isolated, making it easier to take duels and kill groups.
power.loopypowers.explosion.name: Explosion
Explosion is a high damage, combo-based and movement-oriented power, where abilities are intended to be used together to move quickly and deal high amounts of group damage. While also offering some other utilities, like being able to resist all forms of explosion damage, including creepers, end crystals etc. And can also be very destructive.
You take less explosion and fall damage.
Ignite yourself, speeding yourself up and giving yourself jump boost, exploding after a few seconds, damaging anything around you.

Shoot an explosion where you are looking. The recoil will send you flying in the direction you shot the blast from. You will still take fall damage after using this (but less due to the passive). This ability has 2 charges on separate cooldowns.

Shoot yourself in the air with a big explosion at your feet (or shoot yourself when you land if airborne). Each time you land you will explode and be shot up again. On your final explosion, you will briefly pause and do a bigger explosion. These falls will not inflict fall damage and you are free to use other abilities while airborne. Being in water will also pause the fuse (so you will explode when surfacing instead).
power.loopypowers.fire.name: Fire
power.loopypowers.fire.description.overv: Fire is mainly effective at range due to the fireball, which the secondary compliments. It also still has some utility up close, since your hits inflict fire and you do not take fire damage. These abilities are destructive though so be careful.
power.loopypowers.fire.description.passi: You have constant fire resistance and your hits will set entities on fire. This does not stack with fire aspect (the stronger fire will be applied)
power.loopypowers.fire.description.prima: Shoot an explosive fireball in the direction that you are looking. This does extra damage for a direct hit and damages nearby blocks.
power.loopypowers.fire.description.secon: Make an explosion at your feet and shoot up in the air, you will now be levitating using fire for a few seconds and your fireball cooldown will be refreshed. You will not take fall damage when you land. This is supposed to keep you at range from others. You can cancel the levitation by sneaking. This can also be used for movement during your ultimate.
power.loopypowers.fire.description.ultim: Charge up for an extended period of time, surrounding yourself in particles and slowing down greatly. Nearby enemies will be pulled in slightly. After charge unleash a huge explosion damaging anything nearby. This will not damage you.
power.loopypowers.flight.name: Flight
power.loopypowers.flight.description.ove: Flight revolves around mobility, with very little to offer outside of that. Both abilities grant you heightened mobility and the ultimate can be used both for mobility and damage. It is useful for survival but you may have limited tools in combat compared to other powers.
power.loopypowers.flight.description.pas: You permanently have wings as a chestplate that grant you elytra flight. When damaged, any forms of flight are blocked for a few seconds. You cannot remove these wings and they cannot break.
power.loopypowers.flight.description.pri: Gain a burst of momentum in the direction that you're looking and gain a speed boost after, this has 2 charges.
power.loopypowers.flight.description.sec: Launch yourself into the air in an explosion that has high knockback and enter flight, you can burst through ceilings during this at the cost of some damage. If you are grounded this ability cannot be used.
power.loopypowers.flight.description.ult: Can only be used while flying. Stop all movement and briefly charge up. Once charged, shoot off in the direction you're looking with high speed. During flight, nearby entities will be pushed away and if you collide with a solid block, explode nearby entites with high knockback and become grounded for a few seconds.
power.loopypowers.flight.must_be_airborn: §7You must be airborne to use sonic boom.
power.loopypowers.fortune.name: Fortune
power.loopypowers.fortune.description.ov: Yes, this is a gambling power, I just needed a cooler name. Fortune is mainly centered around risk and reward, where your abilities benefit you but also have costs. You have a hidden luck stat that builds when hitting entities and can be enhanced by this stat, so to a degree, the longer you're in a fight the more effective you are.
power.loopypowers.fortune.description.pa:
You have a hidden luck stat that increases when hitting entities and decreases when out of combat. This stat improves chances for jackpots on ability uses or hits. This stat is spent when a jackpot triggers, and you will receive an actionbar alert to what jackpot was used.

On-hit Jackpots:
• Favour: Grants you Speed and Absorption.
• Lucky Shot: Deals extra damage to the target.
• Bad Beat: Inflicts Weakness on the target.
power.loopypowers.fortune.description.pr:
Damage yourself and gain Strength and Speed. You have a chance of hitting 1 of 3 jackpots (odds scale with your luck passive).

Primary Jackpots:
• Raise: Upgrades your buff to Strength II.
• Draw No Bet: Grants you brief Regeneration.
• Double Time: Doubles the duration of your base buffs.
power.loopypowers.fortune.description.se: Shoot a beam that on hit, will put you into a soft duel with the target; you will both deal 50% more damage to each other and take 50% less damage from other sources.
power.loopypowers.fortune.description.ul:
Summon a magical casino cage that quickly builds from your feet, trapping anything inside for a short time. Players can't escape from this once in. Every few seconds, a new House Rule is rolled.

House Rules:
• Loaded Dice: Owner gains Strength.
• Free Drinks: Everyone gains Regeneration.
• VIP Pass: Owner gains Regeneration.
• No Running: Everyone gets Slowness.
• No Fighting: Everyone gets Weakness.
• Double or Nothing: Everyone deals and receives increased damage.
• Shuffle: Everyone swaps positions.
• Roulette: A random entity is damaged.
• Lightning Round: Everyone takes periodic damage.
• Hot Seat: Someone is marked; hit someone to pass it on before it detonates.
• Chip Toss: Some people are launched into the air.
• Wildcards: Random hostile entities are spawned.
• Smoke Machine: Everyone is blinded.
• Spotlight: Someone is marked to glow and takes extra damage.
• Jackpot: The next hit in the room is heavily amplified.
• Card Counter: Owner's luck is instantly set to the maximum.
• The Bouncer: The boundary deals damage and has increased knockback when touched..
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.double_or: Everyone deals and receives increased damage.
Someone is marked; hit someone to pass it on before it detonates.
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.chip_toss: Some people are launched into the air.
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.spotlight: Someone is glowing and takes extra damage.
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.jackpot.d: The next hit in the room is heavily amplified.
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.card_coun: Owner's luck is instantly set to the maximum.
power.loopypowers.fortune.rule.bouncer.d: Touching the wall has increased knockback and damage.
power.loopypowers.healing.name: Healing Factor
power.loopypowers.healing.description.ov: Healing Factor is intended to be a more utility focussed power, with the primary focus being survivability, with some other utility like damage. You can punish people for overcomitting, but may struggle in direct combat due to your limited damage abilities.
power.loopypowers.healing.description.pa: After not being hurt for a while, you will quickly begin to regenerate your health. This does NOT use the regeneration effect and therefore will occur regardless of hunger.
power.loopypowers.healing.description.pr: Heal yourself slightly and purge most negative effects (including some power effects) from you. You will heal more based on the number of effects you clear.
power.loopypowers.healing.description.se: Briefly slow your movement and charge up, during this you take significantly less damage and the damage you take charges up your pulse, the damage and knockback of the pulse scales with the amount of damage you have taken (with a limit) and has range falloff. Your pulse also propagates anyone hit with any vanilla negative effects you had at the time, removing them from you. At higher charges you will emit more particles.
power.loopypowers.healing.description.ul:
Enter a state where you gain different buffs based on your current health. The stages are as follows:
100% - 80%: Overflow - Strength 2, absorption
80% - 60%: Exceptional - Strength 1, slight lifesteal
60% - 40%: Equilibrium - Regeneration, stronger lifesteal, slight smoothing
40% - 20%: Inadequate - Regeneration, resistance, stronger smoothing, cleansing
20% - 0%: Exposed - Speed 2 (with a burst on entry), regeneration, cleansing

There are transition stages where effects briefly overlap when entering a new phase.

Non-potion effects:
Lifesteal - Hits restore health
Smoothing - Reduces large bursts of damage
Cleansing - Periodically removes a negative effect
power.loopypowers.ice.name: Ice
power.loopypowers.ice.description.overvi: Ice is a close-medium range power that revolves around building up freeze and consuming this freeze for high damage. (see the passive for more info) this power's abilities can also effect the environment by freezing water, leaving snow or creating ice spikes.
power.loopypowers.ice.description.passiv: Your melee and ability damage inflicts freeze on targets, (displayed by particles). Higher levels can apply increasing slowness and mining fatigue. At the highest level, the entity will be completedly frozen and have additional blue particles to indicate that they can be shattered. When shattered, the freeze will be consumed, dealing damage and making them immune to freeze briefly after. After a few seconds of not being attacked freeze will decay.
power.loopypowers.ice.description.primar: Cause a group of ice spikes to form where you are looking. These spikes deal damage and knock enemies upwards. If an enemy is fully frozen they will be shattered and if not a high amount of freeze will be applied. This ability travels to your mouse location before forming, meaning there is a visual delay. Spikes will not destroy and blocks and will freeze nearby water if placed on water.
power.loopypowers.ice.description.second: Briefly charge up and shoot out a constant beam of ice, you are slower while you do this. This beam does slight damage, slows and drags enemies downwards as well as applying freeze. This ability will never shatter and cannot pierce blocks. This is intended to be the main freeze builder.
power.loopypowers.ice.description.ultima: Cause a blizzard to form around you, freezing and snowing on your surroundings. There will also be shockwaves produced from your location that will damage, apply freeze and shatter anyone fully frozen. These shockwaves are visual and can be jumped over (although snow layers make it harder to see)
power.loopypowers.lightning.name: Lightning
Lightning is intended to be a close range brawler that can do high amounts of damage to groups of enemies quickly, but very little at range. It should also be said that lightning damage produced is edited (so it doesn't do the normal half a heart that normal lightning does)
Your fist charges up with bonus damage over time. Increased charge can cause lightning to strike the target or chain lightning and ignition to nearby enemies at higher charges.
Create a directional blast of sparks in front of you that damages and ignites entities in a wide cone. Damage falls off with distance.
Empower yourself with lightning, giving yourself temporary regeneration, strength and speed. This emits particles while active.
Create a storm above you, striking random nearby entities with lightning, igniting them and dealing high damage. The cloud particles indicate the range of the ultimate.
power.loopypowers.nature.name: Nature
power.loopypowers.nature.description.ove: Nature is a power centered around area denial, the abilities can lock off areas and entrap entities. Users get buffs in sunlight and water, making you especially deadly in certain zones (particularly in enclosed spaces).
power.loopypowers.nature.description.pas: You gain regeneration in sunlight and in water.
power.loopypowers.nature.description.pri: Create a cloud of expanding poison gas. Anything inside the cloud will be inflicted with poison. You are immune to this gas.
power.loopypowers.nature.description.sec: Conjure a circular cage of thorned vines around you for a long time. Anyone who touches these vines will be slowed and take damage. People with the nature power do not take damage from the vines but are still slowed, the vines are also difficult to break.
power.loopypowers.nature.description.ult: Shoot many vines in front of you. Any enemies close and in direct line of site will be hit by these vines and tethered to their current location, which will keep them trapped in that location, dealing periodic damage and slowing them. When near a tethered energy, the caster becomes empowered with speed and haste.
power.loopypowers.psychic.name: Psychic
power.loopypowers.psychic.description.ov: Psychic focuses on crowd control and manipulating enemy positioning rather than direct damage, you perform better in 1v1 but can work well with groups due to crowd control and sustain.
power.loopypowers.psychic.description.pa: Damaging entities effected by your abilities gives you cooldown reduction and slight healing.
power.loopypowers.psychic.description.pr: Shoot a fast projectile that moves towards your cursor. Hit entities are compelled. Compelled targets are forced to look and walk towards you. This has a range limit and will not walk towards you if not close enough. They are also inflicted with slowness and mining fatigue and will stop when too close, compelled entities cannot hit you but hitting them has a high chance to break control. The projectile has a lifespan and will break if no one is hit within that time.
power.loopypowers.psychic.description.se: Fire a piercing hitscan beam that stuns nearby enemies briefly, effecting them with a stronger slowness initially, and then a weaker more prolonged slowness. The beam can chain to nearby enemies, so you can hit many targets if they're close.
power.loopypowers.psychic.description.ul: Shoot a large, slow-moving projectile that moves towards your cursor. This is similar to compel but with a larger size and hitbox and a slower speed and shorter lifespan. On hit, the entity becomes controlled: Controlled targets are forced to walk and look towards your crosshair and will automatically attack the closest entity (if they are able to attack, they also won't attack you, but hitting them may break control). This has a range limit and entities will not walk towards the cursor if too far. Controlled players will also have constant mining fatigue, making it harder to mine and making them hit slower. Forced attacks when controlled will not account for this.
power.loopypowers.sound.name: Sound
power.loopypowers.sound.description.over: Sound is a primarily ranged power that also offers some (although probably not that great practically) utility in the form of tracking and stunning. These abilities pierce through walls and work best at longer ranges.
power.loopypowers.sound.description.pass: You listening senses are heightened: nearby entities leave lingering sound trails and if they are too conspicuous or close will become resonated, directing you to their position and making them glow. Hitting resonated targets with your abilities deals bonus damage and stuns briefly. Actions such as taking damage are considered conspicuous meaning hits with your abilities can resonate targets. Only you can see the resonation particles but effects like glowing are seen by all.
power.loopypowers.sound.description.prim: Fire a small, long range, piercing projectile in the direction you are looking that damages any entity it touches. Resonated targets will be stunned and take extra damage.
power.loopypowers.sound.description.seco: Do multiple building sound pulses that pull in nearby entities (resonating them if they get too close) and unleash a burst that knocks back any nearby entities and stunning + dealing extra damage to anything resonated.
power.loopypowers.sound.description.ulti: Stop all movement and charge up, unleashing a beam  with huge range that tears up nearby blocks and pierces walls. The range is a lot wider then you will probably see (particle rendering) and hit entities will take high damage and knockback and will also be stunned and take extra damage if resonated; Think of it like a bigger warden beam.
power.loopypowers.speed.name: Speed
power.loopypowers.speed.description.over: Speed mainly focuses on mobility (Who would've guessed!) where most abilities will offer limited direct combat utility, but will provide high speed, making you hard to pin down and kill.
power.loopypowers.speed.description.pass: You have permanent speed. This speed increases temporarily when low on health, with a cooldown.
power.loopypowers.speed.description.prim: Sprint forward in the direction you are looking, hitting an entity damages and knocks them back. This has 2 charges.
power.loopypowers.speed.description.seco: Enter a state where you pinball between nearby entities in your LOS and damage them, this lasts longer the more entities that are nearby as hitting the same entity twice stops the ability early.
power.loopypowers.speed.description.ulti: Become extremely fast and propelled forward constantly. Running into soft blocks will destroy them instantly. Running into more solid blocks will damage and stop movement briefly, but destroy the wall. Colliding with entities will do high damage and knock them away. You can also run on water.
power.loopypowers.strength.name: Strength
power.loopypowers.strength.description.o: Strength is meant to be a simple, rushdown-type kit that is able to quickly close distances and deal insane damage up close but do very little at range. All abilities are meant to compliment the high damage of the normal hits and these abilities are destructive to the nearby environment.
power.loopypowers.strength.description.p: You have constant strength and can break blocks at the mining power and speed of an iron pickaxe when holding nothing. You also have a small boost of mining speed when mining anything with a tool.

Slam the ground or wall in front of you. This does high damage to entities closer to you and knocks them upwards. This slam will damage any ground/walls in front of you. When there is no terrain around you (e.g. When airborne) slams are significantly less effective.
power.loopypowers.strength.description.s: Gain a burst of speed in the direction you are looking, being able to turn at the beginning but being locked to a direction after that. If colliding with an entity, knock them upwards and deal damage. If colliding with a wall, the rush is stopped, the wall is destroyed and you take some self damage. You can stop a rush by sneaking.
power.loopypowers.strength.description.u: Empower yourself greatly, gaining extra strength, resistance and speed. During this ultimate your ability cooldowns will also be greatly decreased and your abilities will be reset on use.
power.loopypowers.telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
power.loopypowers.telekinesis.descriptio: Telekinesis allows you to manipulate enemies and the environment. You excel at isolating targets, controlling their positioning, and utilizing the blocks around you as weapons.
You have extra knockback on melee hit, this stacks with enchantments.
Pull all entities in front of you towards you, this pull will also bring entities upwards, if the pull results in fall damage, this damage will be increased.

Suspend a group of entities in front of you, disabling their movement and floating them into the air. You then have two choices for actions to take:
Swing your hand in any direction and launch the suspended entities in the direction you were looking, entities will take increased fall damage or bonus damage when colliding with a wall.
Do not swing your hand while they are suspended and will begin to choke them, losing the ability to throw them and dealing damage over time.

Surround yourself in telekinetic energy, pulling in nearby entities and damaging them if they are very close.
Nearby natural blocks are pulled from the world and orbit you, swinging will launch some of these blocks in the direction you are looking, dealing AOE damage and knockback.
You must have a certain number of blocks to launch them and you replenish blocks slowly after not swinging for a few seconds.
There are no changes to your movement during this, but your vision may be obscured.
power.loopypowers.teleport.name: Teleportation
power.loopypowers.teleport.primary.name: Blink
power.loopypowers.teleport.ultimate.name: Frenzy
power.loopypowers.teleport.passive.name: Slippy
power.loopypowers.teleport.description.o: Teleportation is focussed on being confusing in battle, where you're more of a mosquito in a fight since you have little direct combat tools and just move around. The abilities revolve around manipulation and being hard to hit, while also being able to do well in setup.
power.loopypowers.teleport.description.p: You have a small chance to dodge an instance of ANY damage, this will then go on a short cooldown before being available again.

You have 3 charges of a teleport that moves you a moderate distance in the direction you're looking. This ability goes on cooldown per charge and prioritises bringing you to a safe location (e.g. putting you on the ground instead of the air). A lingering trail is left between the locations of the teleport and each teleport will reset your attack cooldown, allowing for multi-hit combos.
power.loopypowers.teleport.description.s: Swap places with the entity you're looking at and reset your attack cooldown. The entity will be facing whatever direction they were facing before the teleport, but you will be facing the entity you swapped with. Missing this will still consume the cooldown.
power.loopypowers.teleport.description.u: Become very angry for a period of time and teleport behind a random nearby living entity and swing your weapon repeatedly. The damage inflicted uses the damage from your weapon in your main hand, but enchantments that don't directly edit the weapon damage are not applied (e.g. fire aspect, knockback). The radius of this ultimate is indicated by the particles surrounding and if no entities are nearby, you can just walk around normally, you can cancel this by crouching.
block.loopypowers.celestial_block.toolti: You can feel the power coming off it.
Standing on it increases cooldown recovery speed.
item.loopypowers.empty_vestige.tooltip.i: Imbue it with celestial shards to unlock its potential.
This item is a part of you and cannot be removed.
A powerful item capable of strengthening your bond.
Upgrades a power from Level 1 to 2.
item.loopypowers.perfected_celestial_cor: A legendary item capable of completing your bond.
Upgrades a power from Level 2 to 3.
